''See also: [[Rosephus Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Rosephus is one of two Imperialist [[Champions]] who successfully avoided the [[Gardeners]]. Though he possesses a more average human stature than most [[Champions]], he has a highly muscular build and superhuman physical strength. He is heavily armed, carrying numerous swords and blades attached to his body. In combat, he utilizes a [[Soulbound Vessel]] that manifests as several floating red daggers above his head. Known for his aggressive combat style and loud, booming voice, he is a formidable opponent who relies on both physical weaponry and his supernatural abilities.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Rosephus possesses a muscular physique reminiscent of an [[Izyrian]] statue and bears a shallow cut over one eyebrow. He carries the Emperor's full-face helmet along with several weapons, including three swords buckled to his right hip.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Driven by a rage, Rosephus has been known to destroy walls in an attempt to find someone. He interacts with others by questioning who within a group holds the status of Reader.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As a [[Champion]], Rosephus utilizes a blue [[Soulbound Vessel]] to manifest spectral weapons. His powers include spinning a [[sword]] and controlling three ghostly red daggers that hover around him, as well as wielding a [[sword]] in each hand.}}
